📺 Sirens (2025)

Sirens follows Devon DeWitt, a concerned young woman who travels to a luxurious island estate to reconnect with her younger sister, Simone, who works as a personal assistant to the wealthy and mysterious socialite Michaela Kell. Believing that Simone’s increasingly close relationship with her employer has become unhealthy, Devon attempts to convince her sister to leave behind her glamorous new lifestyle. However, she quickly discovers that Michaela’s seemingly perfect world of wealth, privilege, and sophistication hides complicated relationships, emotional manipulation, and disturbing secrets. Unfolding over a dramatic Labor Day weekend, the story explores the growing tension between the three women as their personal ambitions, insecurities, and loyalties collide. Starring Meghann Fahy, Milly Alcock, Julianne Moore, and Kevin Bacon, the series delivers gripping suspense, dark humor, and compelling performances while exploring sisterhood, power, wealth, social class, identity, and the complicated nature of human relationships.

🎭 Genre: Dark Comedy • Drama • Psychological Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Molly Smith Metzler

📺 Seasons: 1 • 5 Episodes

📚 Based On: The play Elemeno Pea by Molly Smith Metzler.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix.
